scenarios.scenario: Retain a hidden sketch panel after reopening the sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the full Sketch ribbon displays the Pattern panel
the user hides Pattern using Show Panels in the Sketch tab context menu
the user finishes the sketch without changing geometry
the user reopens the same sketch from the model browser
the Sketch ribbon is visible without the Pattern panel
the user opens Show Panels from the Sketch tab context menu
Pattern is unchecked
the user selects Pattern
the Pattern panel returns to the Sketch ribbon

scenarios.scenario: Show and hides the Tutorials panel from the Tools tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Tutorials panel is visible
the user opens Show Panels from a ribbon panel title context menu
Tutorials is checked in the panel list
the user selects Tutorials
the Tutorials panel disappears from the ribbon
Tutorials is unchecked in the panel list
the user selects Tutorials again
the Tutorials panel reappears after Team Web
Tutorials is checked in the panel list
the part remains active
